Screening Eagle Proceq
Proceq Equotip 550 w/ Leeb D & UCI Probe Kit
Pine Item #55934
The Proceq Equotip 550 w/ Leeb D & UCI Probe Kit is a high-precision, dual-technology hardness testing system that combines Leeb D and Ultrasonic Contact Impedance (UCI) probes for comprehensive, non-destructive hardness testing. Designed for laboratory, industrial, and field applications, this system provides accurate hardness measurements on a wide range of materials, from bulk metal structures to thin coatings and welds.
With a user-friendly touchscreen interface, advanced data management, and seamless probe interchangeability, the Equotip 550 is the ultimate solution for professionals in manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, energy, and construction industries.
The Proceq Equotip 550 w/ Leeb D & UCI Probe Kit is a powerful, dual-technology hardness testing solution designed for fast, reliable, and non-destructive hardness measurements. Whether you need to test bulk metal structures, coatings, welds, or heat-affected zones, this system delivers high-precision results with seamless data management and portability.
Product Capabilities
Dual Probe System – Includes Leeb D for bulk materials and UCI for thin materials, coatings, and welds.
Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) – Leaves minimal indentation, ideal for sensitive surfaces.
Versatile Material Testing – Measures hardness in steel, aluminum, titanium, and various alloys.
Rugged & Portable – Lightweight, field-ready design for on-site and industrial use.
Multiple Hardness Scales – Supports HV, HB, HRC, HRB, HS, and more.
Seamless Data Logging & Export – Stores thousands of measurements with USB, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth connectivity.
 Features:
Dual Probe System: Leeb D & UCI
Leeb D for testing large, bulk materials and UCI for coatings, thin materials, and welds.
Advanced Hardness Testing
Delivers precise, repeatable hardness measurements across various materials.
Intuitive Touchscreen Interface
Large, high-resolution color touchscreen with real-time data visualization.
Portable & Durable
Designed for industrial environments with a rugged, ergonomic form factor.
Seamless Data Management
Stores, analyzes, and exports data via USB, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth for easy reporting.
Multiple Hardness Scales
Measures in **HV, HB, HRC, HRB, HS, and more** for flexible global compliance.
 Applications:
Large metal component hardness testing
Thin material and coating hardness evaluation
Weld and heat-affected zone inspections
On-site hardness testing in manufacturing
Aerospace component quality control
Automotive part and tool testing
Pipeline and structural weld integrity assessment
Shipbuilding and marine material inspections
Medical implant and device hardness verification
Energy sector turbine and boiler component testing
 Quantity must be 1 or more
Equipment available for both rental and purchase
